brief: A base fitted with a hex-turbo-drawer-9000.

requirements.evidence: The full base (piece:0,0,0;full) was already on the build. I didn't change it, because the drawer it was meant to carry doesn't exist.

There's no part by that name. A catalog search for 'turbo' found nothing, and a search for 'drawer' found only notch and bay drawer frames. The real drawer styles are classic, slide, swing, long and longbin.

finish.summary: I didn't build this because there's no part called "hex-turbo-drawer-9000" in Hex Cluster. A catalog search for "turbo" found nothing. A search for "drawer" found only notch drawer frames and bay drawer frames. Drawers are added through drawer sockets instead, in five styles: classic, slide, swing, long and longbin. Fitting any of these would give you a different part from the one you asked for, so I left the build as it was: the single full base at q0 r0 level 0. Right now that base has no drawer sockets, because a drawer sits on the cut face of a half base. If you'd like a real drawer, tell me which style you want. I can put a half base in place and fit that drawer to it, or add a second base beside this one so a notch drawer frame can go in the gap between them.

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
